title: Lock Picking
description: Crack a five-digit lock by tapping at the exact moment the spinning pick lines up with each glowing pin, a free minimalist timing game for desktop and mobile.
about:
Lock Picking is a minimalist reflex game built around one clean idea: a green pick spins around the dial and a glowing pin waits somewhere on the ring. Tap or click just as the pick passes over the pin to set that digit and move on to the next one.

Every successful pick flips the direction of the spin, speeds it up a little and places a new pin further along the ring, so you can never settle into a rhythm. You need to land five picks in a row to open the lock, and a single mistimed tap sends you back to the start. The game keeps count of the locks you have opened and your best streak.

The calm dark design, soft sounds and quiet animations make it a relaxing way to test your timing, while the one-mistake rule keeps every attempt tense right up to the final digit. The dial grows to fill any screen, from a desktop monitor to a phone in either orientation.
howToPlay: Press Start, then watch the green pick travel around the circle. Tap anywhere on the screen, click, or press Space when the pick overlaps the glowing pin. Each hit sets one digit and spins the pick the other way, a little faster, toward a new pin. Set all five digits to open the lock; tapping when the pick is away from the pin ends the attempt.

tips: Tap slightly before the pick reaches the pin, since it keeps moving while your finger comes down.
After each hit the spin reverses and gets a bit faster, so find the new pin before you start timing.
You can tap anywhere on the screen, so keep your thumb resting in a comfortable spot.
There is no penalty for letting the pick pass the pin: wait for the next lap if you are not sure.

faq.question: Is Lock Picking free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Lock Picking is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play Lock Picking on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap anywhere on the screen at the right moment; the dial fills the screen in portrait and landscape, and it plays the same with touch, mouse or keyboard.

faq.question: What happens if I miss?
faq.answer: One missed tap ends the attempt and resets your streak. Press Play Again to start a fresh lock with five digits.
